paragraphs.text: Nov 7, 2026 at 8:12 am ET • 2 min read

The top-ranked Miami Hurricanes battle the No. 11 Notre Dame Fighting Irish in a matchup full of College Football Playoff implications on Saturday. Miami is coming off a 38-35 win at North Carolina in Week 9, while Notre Dame defeated Navy 35-13. The Hurricanes (8-0), who lead the ACC at 6-0, are 4-0 on the road this season. They enter Week 10 as one of three remaining unbeaten Power 4 teams. The Fighting Irish (7-1), who are 0-1 against ranked opponents, are 3-0 on their home field. Miami wide receiver Malachi Toney (ankle) is out for this game, which was a big contributor in the spread moving throughout the week.
